facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports on 26 October 2026 that Ghana and Cote d'Ivoire launched roaming under the regional initiative on 14 June 2023, and Ghana launched roaming with Benin and Togo in October 2024.
Ecofin Agency reports on 26 October 2026 that Ghana and Gambia signed a roaming agreement in November 2024.
